features.title: Reorder pending messages
features.summary: Move a queued item up, down, or by drag while preserving its durable identity and respecting next-turn and next-step boundaries.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; choose the initial queue dock expansion state.

failureModes: Move at the first/last boundary is a no-op.
A missing item or absent live agent rejects mutation without changing order.

verification.testName: moves an item one position as a remove plus an insert, keeping its identity
leaves an item at either end in place without splicing
finds an item in the next-step list
reports an item that is no longer pending

features.title: Edit queued messages in the composer
features.summary: Move a queued message's text and attachments into the main composer, show an editing placeholder in its place, and put the edited (Submit) or original (Cancel/Escape) message back at the same position.
failureModes: An attachment cannot be read back, so the message stays queued and unedited.
The message leaves the queue before editing starts, so nothing changes.
A composer submit is rejected, so the edit stays open with its draft.
Restoring the original fails, so the record stays recoverable with Retry or Discard.
A Host started before readFile existed cannot load file attachments; editing those messages reports it and leaves them queued.

verification.testName: Edit moves the text and attachments into the composer and keeps the user draft aside
Submit queues the edited message, with its attachments, back at the same position
Cancel puts the original back unchanged at the same position and discards the composer edits
A finishing turn cannot run the message being edited, and Submit then delivers it exactly once
Editing a message that already left the queue changes nothing
An attachment that cannot be loaded keeps the message queued
A rejected submit keeps the edit open with the draft in the composer
After a reload the saved record still offers Cancel, which restores the original once
A restore that fails stays recoverable until retried
decodeQueuedRows tolerates malformed rows and marks unknown blocks as not editable

features.title: Preview queued message text
features.summary: Show a normalized one-line text preview, hide attachment payloads, and honor the configured character limit without splitting Unicode code points.
failureModes: Text previews split a Unicode code point during truncation.
Image or file payload data is rendered as message text.

verification.testName: flattens text and named blocks while excluding attachments
clips by Unicode code point and appends one ellipsis
